externalMaxCredits.note: Overall 75% program transfer ceiling; exact mapped-course and residency restrictions can require more WGU coursework.

alternativeMaxCredits.note: Alternative learning shares the overall ceiling; no additional credit allowance is added on top.

residencyPolicy.publishedWording: at least 25% of the required Degree Competency Units (excluding the capstone course) at WGU

conservativeSufficientCondition.derivation: 0.25 × 110 = 27.5 noncapstone WGU competency units; the required 4-CU capstone is additional. This is a sufficient planning check under both identified readings, not a claim that WGU publishes a 31.5-CU minimum.

notes: The indexed university transfer guideline excludes the capstone but does not provide a worked numerator/denominator example. Do not substitute a guessed institutionalMinCredits or a 30-semester-credit residency rule.
A plan satisfying this sufficient condition and completing QGT1 at WGU meets both identified interpretations; the precise maximum-transfer floor remains unresolved.
$4,050 per six-month term combines $3,850 tuition and the $200 resource fee. The $65 application fee is separate and is not charged each term.
Outside learning, optional costs, financial aid, discounts and individual remaining-term count are not included. A six-month billing period is not a guaranteed degree completion time.
Complete transfer courses and have original official records evaluated before the first WGU term; no later transfer awards are assumed.
After the original term courses are completed, additional courses may be added with the program mentor. Student mastery and assessment completion determine pace.
The transfer deadline uses the current institutional catalog fifth-day rule; earlier receipt is safer than the marketing page summary.
A generic CU/semester-credit learning equivalence is not proof of an individual outside course award; every source quantity remains separate.

policyReview.message: The complete 36-course, 110-CU BSMGT 202605 curriculum is enforced through named receiving requirements. A separate semester upper-level aggregate is not assumed; this does not remove named-course eligibility, current transfer restrictions or required WGU coursework.

removeUnresolved: WGU course identifiers are populated only where the official Business Management Catalog 05-2026 transfer guideline prints the exact code, title and competency-unit value; other identifiers remain unresolved.

replaceUnresolved.Confirm the exact residency calculation,: WGU publishes a 25% residency rule with a capstone exclusion. The exact floor interpretation remains unresolved; the model stores a source-bound conservative sufficient check instead of an invented flat institutional minimum.

appendUnresolved: Current exact WGU-issued Sophia/Study.com Business Management 202605 receiving agreements were not fully retrievable in this review. Existing provider-published alternatives remain conditional; official general transfer eligibility does not promote a specific equivalency.
appendRulesNotes: The November 2026 university catalog independently verifies all 36 named WGU course codes, their competency-unit amounts and the 110-CU BSMGT 202605 total.

The program-specific guideline identifies eight nontransferable WGU courses totaling 26 CU, including the 4-CU QGT1 capstone. These are enforced as university-only; this is distinct from the broader residency sufficient check.
Current core term charges are $3,850 tuition plus $200 resource fee per six months, with a separate $65 application fee. Personal completion timing remains a pace scenario, not a promise.
